correctness.rationale: The equivalence of global ReLU injectivity with at least two linearly independent positive rows in each direction follows by comparing equal outputs at midpoint, including activation boundaries. Conditional on unoriented lines, independent central symmetry induces independent fair signs. A half-turn visits the m crossings and complementary counts, so success is equivalent to all H_k in [2,m-2]. For uniform angles, consecutive circular gaps form Dirichlet(1,...,1); bad two-consecutive-gap events have probability m/2^(m-1), adjacent intersections 2^-(m-2), nonadjacent disjoint intersection impossible and no triples. Exact inclusion-exclusion gives 1-m(m-2)/2^(m-1), independent of line geometry; the determinant good count follows. Independently reconstructed signed-line dynamic counts exhaustively for m=4..14. No implication for correlated row signs or higher dimensions.
